Triage (routing only): **`domain:devx` appended**, `pm:queue` kept.

- **Routing**: all five suggested changes land in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (skills/process tooling) ⇒ `domain:devx` — precedent #6567 (same class, same lane, queued last round).
- **Grade**: handoff deliverable per the SKILL's own checklist step 7, dedup against #5925/#6490/#6492/#6465/#6207 documented in body — nothing to ask, dispatchable as a docs/skill PR. The five changes are each incident-backed; the implementing dev should keep them as five separately-anchored edits so the maintainer can veto per-item at review.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Four of five lessons landed in PR #6720; lesson 2 is escalated to the maintainer rather than written in.** devx seat, 2026-08-08.

Landed (hence `Part of`, not `Fixes` — this card stays open on L2):

- **L1** — `Fixes` vs `Part of` in the dev template, the review checklist and ACCEPT. A half-landing PR that says `Fixes` silently closes a card sitting in the decision inbox, which only filters **open** issues. Specimen: PR #6600's `Fixes`, caught at review.
- **L3** — a named 「热文件串行队」 section (file → ordered cards → which region each claim covers), added to the handover ledger. Hot-file ordering is a *standing* fact while batch independence is recomputed per round, so it used to die at every handoff.
- **L4** — folded into the `Blocked-by:` reverse-index passage with #6490/#6465: a PM's "this ruling narrows the card" judgment now ships as a **falsifiable PM assumption**, not as a premise. Measured refutation: #6190/#6478.
- **L5** — when a deliverable includes a systematic sweep, the ACCEPT comment lists its products as one block **and names the sweep criterion**, so triage grades the batch consistently.

## L2 — "report at draft-PR time, do not wait for CI" — needs your ruling

The dev declined to write this in, correctly, and the reasoning is worth your eye:

It is a **behavioural change to the dispatch contract**, not a documentation correction, and it contradicts two things currently in force — SKILL.md's own step 7 line (「os-dev 定义侧已要求『PR 开出后等 CI 收敛再交报告』,本条是它在复核侧的对账」) and the standing `os-dev` agent definition. Writing it into one file would leave two files instructing devs in opposite directions, and would silently drop the review-side reconciliation that caught **#5584's red merge**.

The trade-off is real in both directions:

- **For**: up to ~2 h of idle dev time per card waiting on CI (the `domain:cli` seat measured this on #6024). At the volumes this fleet runs, that is the single largest source of dead agent time.
- **Against**: the CI-convergence guarantee is what makes a report's "all gates green" claim mean anything at review. #5584 merged red precisely because a gate's conclusion had not been read; the current rule is the direct response to that incident.

A middle position exists and is worth naming: report at draft-PR time **with** an explicit "CI not yet converged" status, and require the PM to read the job conclusions itself before flipping ready — which the seat already does on every card this tenure. That would recover the idle time without dropping the guarantee, but it moves work from dev to PM and changes what a report *means*, so it is still yours to rule.

⛔ Not dispatching L2 until answered — a dev cannot pick between two files that instruct it in opposite directions. (That is the same shape as #6692, filed today: an agent handed two contradicting instructions does not have a "careful" option.)

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**L2 — the implementing dev's structured options, plus one measurement I did not have.** Sharpening my escalation above rather than replacing it.

**New evidence**: the `domain:metadata` seat ran **5 consecutive dispatches** on the draft-PR-time reporting contract with **zero stalls and zero lost reports**. So option B is not theoretical — it has a run of live practice behind it, on this fleet, today.

**The three coherent positions**:

- **A — leave as is** (dev waits for CI convergence). Costs up to ~2 h idle per card (#6024: four devs measured dying on the wait), but keeps the gate-conclusion reader at the point where the person who can fix a red gate is still live and in context.
- **B — adopt fleet-wide** (dev opens draft PR and reports immediately; PM owns convergence, ready-flip, queueing). ⚠️ Requires editing **both** the os-dev agent definition **and** SKILL.md step 7 in one change, or the contradiction ships.
- **C — per-seat operational choice**, declared per dispatch. Preserves both records, but a dev then cannot know its contract from its own definition — reintroducing the "which rules apply to me this time" ambiguity the two-block dispatch wording exists to remove.

**The decisive observation, and the reason this is worth ruling either way**: *A and B are both coherent, but the **current state is not*** — SKILL.md, the os-dev definition, and the metadata seat's live practice **already disagree with each other**. This is not a proposal to change a working system; it is a request to make an incoherent one coherent in one direction or the other.

The dev recommends **B**, with the sharpest argument being about *duplication rather than relocation*: the duty of reading gate conclusions is currently written in two places and **the dev's copy is the weaker one**, because a dev that dies mid-wait reports nothing at all — which is exactly what happened 7/7 times today (#6586). Moving it wholly to the PM removes the duplicate reader instead of moving it.

⚠️ Counterweight that keeps this a genuine trade rather than an obvious win: the review-side reconciliation exists because **#5584 reported on local green and merged red into `main`**, poisoning every subsequent PR's ESLint job until #5615 hot-fixed it. Whatever is ruled must not drop that check — under B it becomes solely the PM's, which this seat already does on every card this tenure (every ACCEPT here reads the two gate jobs' conclusions directly, never the aggregate).

Still `Part of`, still open, still ⛔ not dispatched until ruled — a dev cannot pick between two files that instruct it in opposite directions.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**L2 — a substantive argument against option B, from the #6586 implementation (PR #6740).** Cross-posted so the ruling has it.

That dev was handed a suggested direction proposing the same move L2 asks for — shift the remote-CI read to the dispatching PM, let the dev report from local verification only — and **declined it as inverted**, with reasoning that is not about preference:

1. **`pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` already forbids the PM from subscribing to a dev's PR before the report lands** — 「⛔ 不订阅 dev 交报告前的 PR —— 报告前是 dev 的领地,双驾驶员互踩」. So option B does not simply move a duty; it collides with a standing rule written to prevent two pilots on one PR. Adopting B means editing that rule too, not just the two files L2 names.
2. **The dev-side CI-convergence bullet exists because of #5584** — a PR that reported on local green and merged red, poisoning `main`'s merge ref for every subsequent PR until #5615 hot-fixed it. Removing the dev's read without a replacement re-opens that exact hole.

Its resolution — worth considering as a **fourth option** alongside A/B/C: keep the CI wait with the dev, but make explicit in the agent definition that it is a **foreground read that terminates in the report**, never a licence for a background waker. That is what PR #6740 landed. It attacks the measured cost (devs dying *while waiting* — 7/7 today) without moving the duty, on the theory that the failure was never the waiting itself but the *passive* waiting.

**How this changes the trade as I framed it above**: I described the choice as "~2 h idle dev time vs the CI-convergence guarantee". If #6740's reading is right, part of that idle time was never inherent to option A — it came from devs waiting in a way that let them be killed. That does not eliminate the cost, and it does not settle L2, but it means **A-as-currently-written and A-as-of-#6740 are different options**, and the measurement that motivated B was taken against the old one.

⚠️ Still true and still the reason this needs ruling: **the current state is incoherent** — SKILL.md, the os-dev definition and the `domain:metadata` seat's live practice disagree with each other. #6740 narrowed the gap on the producer side; it did not close it.

**State correction: `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`. The dispatch finished; what is left is a decision, not work.**

By the devx PM seat (session `session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`).

PR #6799 merged 2026-08-09 01:50Z as `Part of` this card. L1, L3, L4 and L5 were verified already present in the file (landed by PR #6720) and correctly **not** rewritten — restating them would have been the redundant-second-statement defect. That leaves exactly one item:

**L2 — report at draft-PR time vs wait for CI convergence.** Four live options, and PR #6740's dev argues the card's stated direction is inverted. That is a genuine fork on how the dev/PM contract behaves, not something a PM should self-rule, so it belongs in the maintainer's inbox.

Why the label had to move: this card was carrying `pm:queue` **and** `pm:dispatched` at the same time while its actual state was "awaiting the maintainer". All three readings disagreed, and the true one — awaiting a decision — was the only one not expressed by any label. It lived solely in the seat post's prose, which is precisely the failure the protocol names: 座位贴散文不是状态机. A card whose status is only in prose is one no sweep can see and no maintainer filter surfaces.

`needs-user-decision` is the maintainer's inbox filter, so L2 now appears in it. Unassigned, and it is not dispatchable until the fork is answered.

**Maintainer ruling (2026-08-10, directed in session `session_01BPWqbmEFU8gJepBJTHESXd`): approved.**

Write the five lessons into the pm-dispatch SKILL as a normal devx docs card, each lesson tied to its measured incident (the seat's 8-merged / 0-rework / 4-falsifications term is the evidence base). `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`.

Claim: **L2 only**(L1/3/4/5 已由 PR #6720 落地)—— 与 #5925 item 7 **合并处理**(维护者 2026-08-10 指令,本会话),一个 PR、两个 commit(L2 在前,纯搬移在后)。

Session: `session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`
Branch: `claude/issue-5925-6644-skill-md`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-5925-6644`

**L2 形态落定(维护者 05:10Z 裁决 approved + 本轮委托,PM 依此落定并留痕,可在 review 推翻)**:**方案 B + 每单覆盖**。

- dev 默认**开草稿 PR 即交报告**,⛔ 不等 CI;CI 收敛、真实 job conclusions 重读(⛔ 不信 aggregate)、翻牌、入队归 PM —— #5584 的守门职责**移交**到 PM 侧,不是删除。
- 派单 prompt 可对重量级卡显式写「本单等 CI」—— 每单覆盖条款。
- **自洽性是硬要求**(L2 拖两天的全部原因):同 PR 内改齐 SKILL step 5/7、`os-dev` 定义(#6740 后的前台读条款替换为即报条款)、「⛔ 不订阅 dev 交报告前的 PR」规则(报告时点前移至草稿 PR 时,该规则的窗口随之收窄,防双驾驶员的本意保留)。出厂状态 ⛔ 不得存在互相矛盾的两处文本。

**选 B 弃 D 的决定性证据(2026-08-10 本席实测,写进 SKILL 时请引用)**:今天 4 个 dev 有 2 个(#6041、#6906)死于工作进程重启,时点均在**活干完、报告未达**之间 —— #6906 甚至 commit 已打好、分支未推。D(#6740 的前台读)防不住这个:前台读期间进程照样被重启带走。B 把报告时点提到 commit+push 完成即刻,窗口最小化。

**落地**:草稿 PR,`Fixes #5925` + `Fixes #6644`(两卡剩余项均在本 PR 内完结),⛔ 不武装 auto-merge,merge 归维护者。

**车道交接注记**:同 #5925 —— 本席收窄为专办这两卡,车道由新任 PM 接班。

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, this seat's chat session, 2026-08-10: 「关于项目经理的技能,接受你的优化意见,并和前面两个优化任务集中处理。派发使用云卡片,用 Fable 5 模型」. L2 lands in **PR A** of the #7341 cloud dispatch as a standard step-5 template clause plus the step-7 PM landing duty, with the os-dev role file made self-consistent (#7156 is the symptom card, closed by the same PR). L1/L3/L4/L5 remain landed via PR #6799 — PR A adds nothing against them.
